Results.ReviewText: I have not charcoal grilled in maybe 25 years.  My friend and neighbor Tim is a Weber charcoal advocate and I finally became jealous enough to start doing it myself.  Holy cow has Weber gotten even better over time. The ash collector underneath is nothing short of amazing. The porcelain coating makes me think this will last forever. The grates are a breeze to clean. Read the tips and follow them on the website. The lid holder and handles for hanging the grill are an amazing engineering delight.  I think my pellet and NG grill are going to lonely for the next few years.
Results.Title: Returned to charcoal after 25 years

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. I had a smaller one, so I upgraded. Its bigger and I love cooking on it. it cooks really well. I am  thinking on frying a Turkey on it for Thanksgiving.
Results.Title: grill time!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had several bbqs’ in my life, but I always come back to the Weber grill. Years ago, I had a Weber grill that I used a lot. Unfortunately I burned out the bell. I took photos of it and sent them off to your company. Weber sent me a new bell. Did not return my photos or my letter, yet there was no charge. Weber stands behind their grills. This was probably 40 yrs ago.  Thanks Weber.
Results.Title: Good Barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Awesome Grill. I wouldn’t buy anything else. Also love all the accessories you can get and pretty much grill everything.
Results.Title: The one and only

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill! These grills are made well and reliable
Results.Title: These are the best grills! They are well made and

Results.Title: Weber Kettle 22”

Results.ReviewText: I have been a long term Original Premium Charcoal Grill.  Very pleased.
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText: This Weber grill is a nice well-built pit and easy to use.
Results.Title: Our first Weber Grill, a piece of work.

Results.ReviewText: Great quality grill, easy to use, and great smokey flavor. What’s not to like? Also there are tons of accessories for this thing. I bought a slow and sear so I can do two zone cooking and I use this grill all the time now.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my 4th Webber Grill.  I'm 8 years old and love them.  I fell away a couple years ago and bought an off brand kettle grill.   I sent it to the junkyard this year.   The other brand cost me 3 times more for charcoal cause it never sealed at shut down.  Also a pain to clean ashes from....Never again will I stray from a Webber!
Results.Title: After a short absence from Webber, I'm back home!

Results.ReviewText: Works great however the hook to hang the lid off the side is in the worst possible position to the handle.  To hang the lid requires holding the handle in a way that causes more stress than it should to the wrist.  The handle would be better positioned if it were turned 90 degrees.  Can’t figure a reason for it to be the way it is.
Results.Title: Nice grill, one small design concern

Results.ReviewText: Smokes badly between the lid and bowl. Poor performance
Results.Title: Not happy at all

Results.ReviewText: Replaced my aging MasterBuilt Pro smoker. Discontinued and parts no longer available. It had the ash can collector on the bottom like this grill. This Weber grill was an excellent replacement to that tried and true smoker. This grill is well built and works fine.
Results.Title: Surprisingly well built and affordably priced.

Results.ReviewText: my new weber is missing thermometer assembly.  i have contacted customer support but have yet to hear back from them.  therefore i have yet to be able to use it since i bought it around a month ago.  i went w/ weber based on their good name, mistake.
Results.Title: Can't use my brand new Weber

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber and I love how it cooks. It has taken a little getting used to, but overall it works great. I do wish the bottom vent was more clearly identified as to open and close. Other than that, I am very pleased with the product.
Results.Title: Great Cooker!

Results.ReviewText: great and user friendly easy to grill on love this grill, enjoy trying new grilling techniques

Results.ReviewText: This grill is amazing.  We have always cooked with gas or on a pellet smoker so this was our first experience with charcoal.  Our family absolutely loves it.  We use multiple times a week.
Results.Title: Grill

Results.ReviewText: I cook a lot on a gas grill, over open firepit, and a LOT on a pellet smoker.  recently my wife and I both wanted the taste of BBQing from our youth when everyone only had charcoal...  bought this Weber kettle and quickly learned how to control the temp, cook over direct and indirect heat, etc.   we have used it probably 10-12 time already and we LOVE it..  very happy with our purchase .. will continue to use it as primary outside cooking device... very satisfied with our choice
Results.Title: new charcoal user

Results.ReviewText: Love it, use it ss w smoker and a regular grill. Fine quality product
Results.Title: Best grill ever,  will never buy any other brand

Results.ReviewText: Great product. Weber lives up to their warranty. Always register your purchases.
Results.Title: 2nd to none

After providing a few pics showing the issue I was having, Maryah informed me they would be sending me a new grill base and lid. Could not be happier with grill and Webers outstanding customer service.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: I have used Weber kettle grills for over 40 years, Always delivers a great meal experience. Product is well constructed and engineered. I always tell people "You can never go wrong with a Weber"
Results.Title: Original Weber Kettle 22" The best!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second big boy.  I started out back in the day with the Smokey Joe recommended by a coworker and loved it. Thanks.
Results.Title: Original Charcoal Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: great product, but if you want to hear a really great Weber story, Weber needs to contact me! I have had Weber grills for over 40 years
Results.Title: New Weber

Results.ReviewText: Great product and well built. Love to cook now. I have a couple of wishes on the design like maybe another handle to hang things on but otherwise this thing rocks!
Results.Title: I love the Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, maintain, and control heat temperatures
Results.Title: The Weber Kettle Grill is #1 in charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Always wanted a weber grill, and have not be disappointed. Nothing but good experiences with this grill highly recommend.
Results.Title: Recommend

Results.ReviewText: Great to get started on some smoking and grilling!
Results.Title: Best grill ever!

Results.ReviewText: Incredibly easy set up, well designed charcoal disposal system and seemingly built to last! I had one of these years ago and regretted giving it away when I moved. I have an expensive pellet smoker and reverse sear steaks from time to time, but nothing beats cooking a steak over direct fire with lump charcoal and hardwood coals. Definitely a must, and so much more affordable than something like a ceramic egg design. If this design is good enough for Adam Perry Lang then it’s good enough for me! I got this grill at Ace and really like the indigo blue color: subtle but unique.
Results.Title: Must have for live fire cooking!

Photos.Caption: Two full high baskets for the initial burn in.

Results.ReviewText: I've only had experience with cheap portable charcoal grills in the past. Those don't keep heat at all. I've read and watched info about the Weber Kettle and cooking methods and gave it a try. This holds the heat well. With charcoal baskets I can cook small quantities with only half the charcoal. Using the baskets allow that great steak sear. I have also roasted/smoked a turkey. The temperature control is excellent and the ash basket is a must. I should have bought this sooner.
Results.Title: It works!

Results.ReviewText: Weber makes the best charcoal fired BBQ grills.  I bought my first one over twenty years ago and it was time to buy a new one, as it's life had come to an end.  I then went to my local store and bought a new Weber charcoal grill, assembled it and now I am continuing to enjoy grilling with Weber.  I encourage anyone who wants a reliable, well-built and user-friendly grill, definitely check out the line of Weber grills that will meet your needs.
Results.Title: Weber's Awesome Charcoal Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Let me preface my review by stating that, over the years, I have owned at least five Weber grills that I can recall. All have lived long, useful lives. All have been easy to operate, until my latest purchase. In April 2024, I purchased a new Weber grill. Overall, it is as easy to use as all my others, except for two things. There is a small ( and I mean small ) hook on the inside of the lid to be used to hang the lid on the side of the kettle. It is so small that a gust of wind caused the lid to fall off, chipping the paint and resulting with my having to deal with customer service. Can you make that hook a little longer?
   Secondly, whoever designed that new ash catcher should be reassigned. Either I am doing something wrong when I try to lower it to dump the ashes or you must have the strength of Arnold Schwarzenegger to get it to work. The old ashcatchers were sometimes tricky to use, but, overall, were MUCH simpler. I am an old guy and my strength, as they say, ain't what it used to be. Also,being an old guy, I remember an expression " if it ain't broke,don't fix it". Now you know why I gave my new Weber grill four stars, not five,
Results.Title: Good Old Grill, But...

Results.ReviewText: Cooks fine but the ash catcher is difficult to re-attach after you dump it.
Results.Title: 22" Weber

Results.ReviewText: Great classic style kettle grill.  You just can’t beat the taste of food cooked over a real wood fire.
Results.Title: Mr.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this to replace my 15 year old Weber Original Kettle Premium Charcoal 22”Grill.  The best grill I’ve owned.
Results.Title: Best Grill I’ve Owned

Results.ReviewText: I had bought the 22” premium kettle and after a couple cooks really the bowl was egg shaped. They got ahold of me and sent the replacement parts no charge. New bowl and lid. Would highly recommended this grill.
Results.Title: Amazing grill even better customer service

Results.ReviewText: I've had it 2 weeks and already love it! The 22" grate means enough meat on the grill for 10 people is easy and things like setting up two zones or convection grilling is totally a possibility. The trash trap makes for clearing excess charcoal easily. Love the hooks built into the handle, and as it's a smaller grill than some propanes, it makes for easier storage.
Results.Title: 5 Reasons Why

Results.ReviewText: Fine product. The ash catcher is a great addition.
Results.Title: Nice Upgrade

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill but disappointed that it came in damaged.  Damage was done pryor to shipping.  Poor quality control if you ask me.  Should take more pride when sending out products.  Just waiting for new part to come in, is a hassle.
Results.Title: Love it, but came damaged.

Results.ReviewText: Easy to set-up and use.  Great for grilling and bbq.  Ribs come out amazing!
Results.Title: Amazing Ribs!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Kettle Grill. The first was one of the original basic Weber grills. I do enjoy all the updated features. I actually wanted to purchase the Performer Deluxe with gas start, but couldn’t justify the huge price difference when the actual cooking portion is virtually the same. The Weber build quality is very solid. From steaks to brisket to whole turkey everything turns out exceptionally. Not disappointed in my purchase.
Results.Title: Kettle Bliss

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill. Nothing like something cooked on charcoal. Cooks evenly. We love it!!!
Results.Title: Birthday gift!

Results.ReviewText: No one should be without a Weber Kettle! Experienced folks to a first timer, it's a classic and the best!
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Love!

Results.ReviewText: Now matter how many types of grills, griddles, smokers... whatever. You just can't beat the classic kettle. You gotta enjoy the process, because that's half the fun of cooking on these things
Results.Title: I Always Come Back

Results.ReviewText: This is my fourth Weber in forty years and cook year round regardless of weather.  This unit is flimsy compared to the older versions.  Ash catcher is clumsy to empty, lid doesn't fit well.  Hook for lid, vent, handle and thermometer should be turned 90 degrees.  Not sure I will purchase a Weber next time around.  Would rather had paid more money for better quality.
Results.Title: Poor Rating

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Took me a few times before I got the hang of it, but now I wonder why I kept my old one so long. Mine’s the copper color, has a painting flaw, but overall still good-looking.
Results.Title: Fan

Results.ReviewText: Wasn't happy having file a claim to replace parts that fell apart glade it was taking care of just thought webber had better quality
Results.Title: Good but not great

Results.ReviewText: Forty years have passed since I owned a Weber charcoal grill. In the intervening years I owned natural gas or propane grills for what I believed to be efficiency and ease of use. In the last 30 days I have been reminded of the amazing taste of everything cooked on a charcoal grill. The upgrades Weber has made to the original grill have made it easier to use while the price remains an absolute bargain. I look forward to having many meals cooked on my Weber until my cooking days are over.
Results.Title: Back home again

Results.ReviewText: I've been using the original 22 inch Weber for  over 40 years and I just upgraded to the Kettle Premium 22 inch it is A 10  thanks Weber
Results.Title: Keep on Cooking

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
